units.source_text: 我想起刚才跟他吵过架，所以一声不吭，只是伸手接过油灯。

en.t: I remembered that I had quarreled with him just now, so I said nothing and only reached out to take the oil lamp.

units.source_text: 哥哥转身就走，没想到突然有转回头，

en.t: My older brother turned to leave, but unexpectedly he suddenly turned back,

units.source_text: 把手放在人力车的挡泥板上，说：

en.t: put his hand on the rickshaw's fender, and said:

units.source_text: “阿鹤，你别再跟爸爸说雏人偶的事情了。”

en.t: "O-Tsuru, don't talk to Father about the dolls anymore."
